items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
OBSERVED CONTROLS: WASD moves; short taps (~0.25-0.4s) nudge, ~0.8-1.5s holds move noticeably farther, ~1.8s covers more; camera scrolls with character. Space = 'Do Action' (contextual pick/harvest), works only with verified in-range target. LMB on world objects selects/examines; hovering shows verb labels. Escape opens Paused menu (Continue, Controls, Settings, Save, Quit). Controls menu: Primary LMB, Secondary RMB, Force Inspect Left Alt, Force Attack Left Ctrl, Do Attack F, Do Action Space, Move WASD; no craft key listed. Tab toggles map.

PICKING MECHANICS (observed): Reliable pattern = approach target from open side, keep character level with it (same y) rather than from below, hover its exact colored pixels until 'Pick X' appears, then Space. Hover labels: 'Pick Flower/Sapling/Grass' when in range; 'Examine X' when out of range OR when standing on/overlapping the target. Pick range is tight/asymmetric (up-screen targets worked better than horizontal). Trunks/branches steal hover and cause 'Examine Evergreen' even when the tuft looks clear — aim at the tuft's own pixels (e.g. orange clump right of trunk). Pines can hide the character. Results: flowers -> petals (slot stacks); saplings -> twigs (sometimes leaving ground drop); grass tufts -> grass. Grass tufts frequently hug pine bases and must be approached from the side/level.

GROUND DROPS: an object assumed to be a stick showed verb 'Pick up Seeds' — ground items are not all twigs; read the verb. Walk-over auto-collection was attempted repeatedly on drops near the character's feet and repeatedly failed to collect them; treat walk-over as unreliable (uncertain) and prefer hover+Space. Sapling-derived twig drops did auto-collect once after stepping away and back.

CRAFTING UI (observed): left sidebar category icons (axe ~y0.13, flame 'Light' ~y0.185, plus trap/yarn/sword/cup/survival lower). Clicking flame icon expands a column of recipe tiles at x~0.117, top tile ~y0.16 (flame-swirl = likely torch). Silhouetted/dark tiles = probably unaffordable or locked (guess). Hovering a tile produced a detail panel with exact costs and a Build button in an EARLIER session (campfire = 3 cut grass + 2 logs); in the later session hovering the Light tiles repeatedly produced NO tooltip, and clicking the bright/affordable-looking top tile produced no visible change, and pressing Space right after also produced no visible effect. So exact craft activation remains UNRESOLVED.

DARKNESS: screen dims to near-total black with starry vignette at night; in darkness the character takes repeated hits ('OW! Something hit me!', 'What was that?!') and total darkness previously ended a run (death). Night arrived while still gathering — the transition was sudden and caught the run unprepared.

FAILED STRATEGIES (do not repeat): click-to-harvest world objects; Space from too far or through a trunk; standing on top of a target (yields Examine); hovering trunk instead of tuft pixels; assuming ground drops are sticks; spamming category clicks or tile clicks with no feedback; expecting tooltips without precise hover; wasting daylight debugging the craft UI.

UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES (guesses, unconfirmed): silhouetted Light tiles = insufficient ingredients; torch is cheaper than campfire (maybe grass+twigs) and its cost was never successfully read; craft activation may be a Build button in the hover panel, a keyboard crafting panel (W/S categories, A/D recipes, Space craft), or require selecting a tile then Space; a bottom-right scroll/document icon (~0.93,0.89) was never explored.

LESSONS FOR NEXT RUN: treat daylight as a hard deadline — resolve the Light/torch recipe cost and craft activation EARLY, then build light well before dusk. Gather grass and twigs in quantity first (grass tufts beside pines, saplings for twigs); read each ground item's verb before assuming. Verify 'Pick' via hover, approach level and from the open side, step off targets that read 'Examine'. Never remain in total darkness.
